section_summary: This section closes correspondence about attempted customs and plant-quarantine violations during the Japanese tanker Erimo’s visit to California. Most pages concern proposed 1937 visits by Japanese training ships and naval transports, requests for routine port courtesies, and replies from U.S. departments. The Taisei Maru’s planned cruise was later cancelled because the ship needed repairs.

subfiles.title: Japanese embassy reply concerning Erimo incident
subfiles.about: Japan promises to investigate attempted customs evasion involving Erimo.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador reports preventive steps and promises a further reply after receiving Tokyo’s findings.

subfiles.title: Plant-quarantine complaint about Erimo
subfiles.about: Erimo officers attempted to take a prohibited dwarf pine ashore at San Pedro.
subfiles.summary: After being told the tree could not enter, the captain and another officer carried it ashore in a box, resisted inspection, and summoned armed sailors. Agriculture requests referral to the Japanese ambassador.

subfiles.title: Reply to Agriculture about Erimo
subfiles.about: State reports Japanese assurances following the Erimo incident.
subfiles.summary: The embassy said it took the matter seriously, would report it to Japan, discipline the officers, and prevent recurrence.

subfiles.title: Proposed visits of Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru
subfiles.about: Japan requests approval and courtesies for two training ships visiting Hawaiian ports.
subfiles.summary: The note gives crews, captains and itineraries: Nihon Maru at Hilo in June and Kaio Maru at Port Allen in late July and August. Sailing conditions may alter the dates.

subfiles.title: Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru referral to Agriculture
subfiles.about: State asks Agriculture to extend usual courtesies to two Japanese training ships.
subfiles.summary: Forwards their Hawaiian visit schedules.

subfiles.title: Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru referral to Interior
subfiles.about: State asks Interior to extend usual courtesies to two Japanese training ships.
subfiles.summary: Forwards their Hawaiian visit schedules.

subfiles.title: Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru referral to Labor
subfiles.about: State asks Labor to extend usual courtesies to two Japanese training ships.
subfiles.summary: Forwards their Hawaiian visit schedules.

subfiles.title: Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru referral to Navy
subfiles.about: State requests Navy courtesies for Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the embassy note and itineraries.

subfiles.title: Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru referral to Treasury
subfiles.about: State asks Treasury to extend usual courtesies to two Japanese training ships.
subfiles.summary: Forwards their Hawaiian visit schedules.

subfiles.title: Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru referral to War
subfiles.about: State asks War to extend usual courtesies to two Japanese training ships.
subfiles.summary: Forwards their Hawaiian visit schedules.

subfiles.title: Interim acknowledgment of training-ship request
subfiles.about: State acknowledges the proposed Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru visits.
subfiles.summary: The Secretary says interested departments have been consulted and promises an answer on the proposed Hawaiian calls.

subfiles.title: Handwritten Far Eastern Affairs memorandum
subfiles.about: An internal handwritten note discusses the Erimo case.
subfiles.summary: The legible text refers to the Erimo case and Tokyo; the remaining handwriting is unclear.

subfiles.title: Navy cover letter on Erimo incident
subfiles.about: A Navy officer forwards a letter on the Erimo incident.
subfiles.summary: Requests referral to the proper office and return after use.

subfiles.title: War Department response on training ships
subfiles.about: War arranges courtesies for Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru in Hawaii.
subfiles.summary: The Hawaiian Department has been instructed to assist both vessels.

subfiles.title: Immigration response on training ships
subfiles.about: Immigration will extend lawful courtesies to Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru.
subfiles.summary: The Honolulu district director is being instructed.

subfiles.title: Copy of Immigration response on training ships
subfiles.about: A second copy records Immigration’s response to the training-ship visits.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the Honolulu courtesy instructions.

subfiles.title: Proposed visits of four Japanese transports
subfiles.about: Japan seeks approval for Ondo, Erimo, Sunosaki and Hayatomo to take on supplies.
subfiles.summary: The note identifies each captain and proposed calls at San Francisco, Hilo, Los Angeles, Honolulu or Manila between May and June 1937. It requests customary facilities.

subfiles.title: Transport-visit referral to California
subfiles.about: State forwards the four transports’ schedules and requests customary courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Lists the vessels, captains and proposed port calls.

subfiles.title: Transport-visit referral to Agriculture
subfiles.about: State requests Agriculture’s cooperation with four Japanese transport visits.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the proposed supply-call schedules.

subfiles.title: Transport-visit referral to Interior
subfiles.about: State requests Interior’s cooperation with four Japanese transport visits.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the proposed supply-call schedules.

subfiles.title: Transport-visit referral to Labor
subfiles.about: State requests Labor’s cooperation with four Japanese transport visits.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the proposed supply-call schedules.

subfiles.title: Transport-visit referral to Navy
subfiles.about: State asks Navy to arrange courtesies for four Japanese transports.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Japanese embassy’s schedules.

subfiles.title: Transport-visit referral to War
subfiles.about: State requests War Department cooperation with four Japanese transport visits.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the proposed supply-call schedules.

subfiles.title: Transport-visit referral to Treasury
subfiles.about: State requests Treasury cooperation with four Japanese transport visits.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the proposed supply-call schedules.

subfiles.title: Interim acknowledgment of transport request
subfiles.about: State acknowledges the proposed visits of Ondo, Erimo, Sunosaki and Hayatomo.
subfiles.summary: Interested authorities and California’s governor have been consulted.

subfiles.title: Cross-reference to Hawaiian naval maneuver memorandum
subfiles.about: A file note points to a memorandum on foreign vessels during Hawaiian naval maneuvers.
subfiles.summary: Navy recommended excluding foreign public vessels from Hawaiian ports during April 21–May 21 maneuvers.

subfiles.title: Navy consent to training-ship visits
subfiles.about: Navy raises no objection to Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru visiting Hawaii.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities have been directed to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Approval of Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru visits
subfiles.about: State approves the two training ships’ Hawaiian visits.
subfiles.summary: Usual courtesies and facilities will be extended.

subfiles.title: Treasury response on training ships
subfiles.about: Treasury authorizes customs courtesies for Nihon Maru and Kaio Maru.
subfiles.summary: The Honolulu customs collector is being instructed.

subfiles.title: War Department response on transports
subfiles.about: War arranges courtesies for the four Japanese transports.
subfiles.summary: Commands in California, Hawaii and the Philippines were notified, as was the Bureau of Insular Affairs.

subfiles.title: Navy reservation about San Francisco arrival dates
subfiles.about: Navy asks three Japanese transports to avoid San Francisco on fleet arrival and departure dates.
subfiles.summary: Ondo, Erimo and Sunosaki should neither arrive nor depart May 28 or June 4; Navy otherwise has no objection.

subfiles.title: Conditional approval of transport visits
subfiles.about: State approves transport visits subject to Navy’s San Francisco scheduling restriction.
subfiles.summary: The note asks that Ondo, Erimo and Sunosaki avoid arriving or departing San Francisco on May 28 and June 4, when the U.S. Fleet moves through the harbor. Other proposed calls are acceptable.

subfiles.title: Immigration response on transports
subfiles.about: Immigration will extend lawful courtesies to personnel of four Japanese transports.
subfiles.summary: District directors at San Francisco, Los Angeles and Honolulu are being instructed.

subfiles.title: Treasury response on transports
subfiles.about: Treasury authorizes customs courtesies for three transports in its districts.
subfiles.summary: It issues no authorization for Hayatomo’s Philippine call, which falls under War Department jurisdiction.

subfiles.title: Proposed Taisei Maru training cruise
subfiles.about: Japan seeks approval for Taisei Maru visits to Portland and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: The note gives Captain Naraji Ono, personnel totals and July–August dates.

subfiles.title: Taisei Maru referral to Oregon
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies for Taisei Maru’s planned Portland call.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the Portland and Honolulu itinerary.

subfiles.title: Taisei Maru referral to Navy
subfiles.about: State asks Navy to arrange courtesies for Taisei Maru.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the proposed training-cruise itinerary.

subfiles.title: Taisei Maru referral to Agriculture
subfiles.about: State requests Agriculture’s cooperation with Taisei Maru’s planned visits.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the Portland and Honolulu itinerary.

subfiles.title: Taisei Maru referral to Interior

subfiles.summary: Forwards the Portland and Honolulu itinerary.

subfiles.summary: Forwards the Portland and Honolulu itinerary.

subfiles.summary: Forwards the Portland and Honolulu itinerary.

subfiles.summary: Forwards the Portland and Honolulu itinerary.

subfiles.title: Interim acknowledgment of Taisei Maru request
subfiles.about: State acknowledges Taisei Maru’s proposed Portland and Honolulu visits.
subfiles.summary: Interested departments and Oregon’s governor have been consulted; a further answer is promised.

subfiles.title: Proposed Shintoku Maru training cruise

subfiles.summary: The proposed calls fall in July and August 1937.

subfiles.title: Shintoku Maru referral to Oregon
subfiles.about: State requests courtesies for Shintoku Maru’s planned Marshfield call.
subfiles.summary: Forwards its Marshfield and Kahului schedule.

subfiles.title: Shintoku Maru referral to Agriculture

subfiles.summary: Forwards its Marshfield and Kahului schedule.

subfiles.title: Shintoku Maru referral to Treasury

subfiles.title: War Department response on Taisei Maru
subfiles.about: War instructs regional commands to assist Taisei Maru at Portland and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: The Ninth Corps Area and Hawaiian Department received courtesy instructions.

subfiles.title: Cancellation of Taisei Maru cruise
subfiles.about: Japan cancels Taisei Maru’s planned American visits.
subfiles.summary: Repairs and improvements prevent the ship from sailing.

subfiles.title: Taisei Maru cancellation notice to Oregon
subfiles.about: State advises Oregon that Taisei Maru will not visit.
subfiles.summary: Repairs have cancelled the cruise.

subfiles.title: Immigration response on Taisei Maru
subfiles.about: Immigration instructs Portland and Honolulu offices to extend lawful courtesies to Taisei Maru.
subfiles.summary: The response concerns the original planned visits, despite the intervening cancellation.

subfiles.title: Oregon governor’s acknowledgment of Taisei Maru
subfiles.about: Oregon’s governor acknowledges Taisei Maru’s proposed Portland arrival.
subfiles.summary: He refers the information to the Portland Chamber of Commerce.

subfiles.title: War Department response on Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: War instructs regional commands to assist Shintoku Maru.
subfiles.summary: The Ninth Corps Area and Hawaiian Department received courtesy instructions.

subfiles.title: Navy routing note on Taisei Maru
subfiles.from: Office of the Chief of Naval Operations
subfiles.about: An internal Navy note addresses proposed courtesies for Taisei Maru.
subfiles.summary: The legible text says customary courtesies and facilities would be extended.

subfiles.title: Hawaii governor’s response on Japanese transports
subfiles.about: Hawaii’s governor promises usual courtesies to Japanese transports at Hilo and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Interior forwarded the letter to State on June 7.

subfiles.title: Navy response on Taisei Maru
subfiles.about: Navy raises no objection to Taisei Maru’s proposed Portland and Honolulu visits.
subfiles.summary: Appropriate naval authorities would be asked to extend customary courtesies.
